texts.li: {A_nameDef} cut {X_nameDef} a slice of the colony's cheese. {X_nameDef} chewed slowly, said nothing, and held out {X_possessive} hand for another.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} how long the colony ages its cheese, and the two of them ended up in the cellar arguing about rinds.
For a slice of the colony's best cheese, {X_nameDef} gave {A_nameDef} the news from three villages and {X_possessive} grandmother's way with pickled onions.
[skill:Cooking] {X_nameDef} wanted to know what {A_nameDef} puts in the brine. {A_nameDef} told {X_objective} everything except the important part.
{X_nameDef} sniffed the cup {A_nameDef} poured, swirled it, sniffed again, and pronounced the colony's wine "young, but honest".
{A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} the barrels. {X_nameDef} knocked on each one and listened, the way {X_possessive} grandfather taught {X_objective}.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that where {X_pronoun} comes from they bury a bottle under the threshold when a child is born, and drink it at the wedding.
[winter] {A_nameDef} and {X_nameDef} warmed a pot of the colony's wine with honey and spice and finished it between them.
{X_nameDef} pulled a stool up to the colony's hearth beside {A_nameDef}, and they sat watching the logs settle without needing to say much.
{A_nameDef} banked the hearth for the night while {X_nameDef} told {A_objective} how they keep a fire in all winter where {X_pronoun} comes from.
[cold] {X_nameDef} came in blue with cold, and {A_nameDef} sat {X_objective} so close to the hearth that {X_possessive} boots steamed.
[rain] {X_nameDef} and {A_nameDef} dried their coats in front of the hearth and roasted chestnuts while the rain came down outside.
The smell from the colony's oven brought {X_nameDef} round to the kitchen door, where {A_nameDef} handed over the end of a loaf still too hot to hold.
{X_nameDef} watched {A_nameDef} pull the loaves from the oven with a long paddle and asked to try. The second loaf survived.
[x:child] {X_nameDef} hung about the oven all morning until {A_nameDef} gave {X_objective} a little loaf of {X_possessive} own.
{A_nameDef} took {X_nameDef} out to the colony's hives. {X_nameDef} stood very still with a bee walking across {X_possessive} knuckles, and only breathed again when it left.
{X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that you must tell the bees when someone in the house dies, or they'll leave. {A_nameDef} hadn't heard that, and has been thinking about it since.
{A_nameDef} gave {X_nameDef} a piece of honeycomb straight from the hive, and {X_nameDef} ate it, wax and all.
{X_nameDef} asked to see the colony's books, and {A_nameDef} showed {X_objective} every one, including the one with the candle burn on the cover.
{X_nameDef} can read, which is rarer than it should be, and spent the afternoon at the scribe's table with {A_nameDef}, comparing letters.
{A_nameDef} copied out a page of {X_nameDef}'s little book of remedies and drew {X_objective} the colony's map of the roads in return, and they argued over the spelling of every village on it.
